reports.title: Manon Jones: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Wales prevention of future deaths reports (2019 onwards)

concerns.quote: The clinicians assessing Manon on admission to Ty Llidiard did not have available to them the records of her care made in the community by the Crisis team, the Community Intensive Treatment team or the University Hospital of Wales
The Clinical records in the Ty Llidiard Unit were not all entered contemporaneously in a single clinical record

The absence of a single in and outpatient clinical record impaired the ability of the clinicans at the unit on admission to be able to assess Manon, fix a safe levels of observations, and safeguard her

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that clinicians cannot readily obtain a complete, up‑to‑date set of a patient’s clinical records. The earlier issue concerned missing contemporaneous entries in a single record; the later issue notes practitioners lack easy access to all relevant records pending a unified system.
